newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NBP cuts 1-day rev repo max to 15.90 pct.
newsitem.headline: Polish NBP cuts 1-day rev repo max to 15.90 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland said it cut its maximum accepted one-day reverse repo rate to 15.90 percent from 17.70 percent at its last three-day drainage on Friday.
The bank set the average rate at 15.22 percent, down from 16.86 percent for the three-day reverse repo. Its last 14-day reverse repo rate was 19.12 percent on August 20.
It said it drained 2.15 billion zlotys from the market through a reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction after banks bid to place 2.93 billion with it.
